chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Supplication is the weapon of the believer, and the pillar of the religion, and the light of the heavens and the earth. [So upon you is to use supplication and purify the intention.]
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of supplication in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) elevates supplication to a cosmic and spiritual necessity, describing it as the believer's weapon, the pillar of religion, and the light of the heavens and earth. This narration underscores the Shia emphasis on *dua* not merely as a ritual act but as an active means of connecting with the Divine Will, requiring the purification of intention (*ikhlas*) to maximize its efficacy.
